found.truth_sql: SELECT maxOrNull(c2) AS o0 FROM (SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'Australia/Sydney')) AS c0, p.category AS c1, toFloat64(sumOrNull(if(o.status IN ('completed','shipped'), o.amount, NULL))) / nullIf(toFloat64(sumOrNull(o.amount)), 0) AS c2 FROM shop.orders o LEFT JOIN shop.users u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop.products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE (o.product_id IN (29)) GROUP BY c0, c1) WHERE (toDate(toDateTime64(c0, 3, 'Australia/Sydney')) = toDate('2025-03-31')) SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
